gaps.GET /v1/a2a/agents/:agentId/role-grants/: exports the roles that may call a remote agent (ADR-0226 list contract)

gaps.DELETE /v1/a2a/agents/:agentId/role-gran: removes a role's access to a remote agent (audited)
gaps.GET /v1/a2a/agents/:agentId/revocations: lists the people whose role-derived access to a remote agent is revoked
gaps.GET /v1/a2a/agents/:agentId/revocations/: exports the revocations on a remote agent (ADR-0226 list contract)
gaps.POST /v1/a2a/agents/:agentId/revocations: revokes one person's role-derived access to a remote agent (audited)
